versions.changelog: Add skill cards and standardized growth registry metadata
Switch public terms to CC BY-NC-SA + commercial license

- Initial release of comment-to-content-recycler skill.
- Transforms audience comments, DMs, and FAQ threads into prioritized, script-ready content ideas.
- Groups and ranks inputs by intent (how-to, comparison, troubleshooting, buying concerns, objections/myths).
- Scores clusters based on frequency, urgency, monetization relevance, and ease of production.
- Generates top content topics with hooks, angles, and tailored CTAs.
- Suggests which comments to reply to first and provides a follow-up question for improved feedback.
